_readme: Faith Works practical resources: the single source for resource cards on Home, Learn and Implement. Add a record and it appears in every resource list; no HTML changes. FIELDS: id (stable; also the value the Implement request form uses) · title · type (Guide | Framework | Checklist | Worksheet | Plan | Program | Event | Article — drives the card's mark) · category (label shown on cards) · topics (filter keys: ai, business, leadership, lifestyle, faith-purpose) · description · image (every resource has one: { base + widths } or a plain path string with imageAlt) · url (where it's explained or requested) · downloadUrl (a direct file link once one exists; null until then) · status ('available' = open now · 'on-request' = sent by email; the card links to the sign-up on Implement (#access) · 'coming-soon') · ctaLabel · featured (true on ONE resource: leads Learn's Resources and Home) · eventRef (optional: the id of an events.json record; title, description, image, date and registration link then come from that event, so they're never written twice).
